items.canonicalEnglishName: Sweet potato, thickly peeled, cut 1 cm wide and soaked in water for 30 minutes
items.fdcDescription: Sweet potato, raw, unprepared (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
items.notes: Explicit semantic review binds this uncooked sweet-potato preparation to USDA sweet potato, raw, unprepared. Thick peeling, cutting, and a 30-minute water soak do not change the underlying food identity or create a cooked product, but they may modestly alter the edible portion or water-soluble nutrients, so confidence is medium rather than high. The USDA record is used only as the per-100-g raw sweet-potato nutrition reference; Cook4Me does not infer skin contribution, soak loss, water uptake, drained yield, serving mass, or any cooking conversion. Cooked, canned, fried, candied, frozen, or paste forms remain separate identities.
